requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Identification block - Arrest Tracking Number
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Identification block - Arrest Tracking Number
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the ATN is assigned by Arkansas ACIC when an arrest is processed and identifies the arrest through a system the platform has no knowledge of
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the ATN, copied from your arrest paperwork or your ACIC criminal-history record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Verification - "STATE OF ARKANSAS / COUNTY OF ______"
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Verification - "STATE OF ARKANSAS / COUNTY OF ______"
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the county of a notarial oath is where the participant happens to be sworn, which the platform does not know
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the county in which you swear the verification before the notary - the notary can tell you, and it need not be the county of the court

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Caption - the county in "COURT OF ________, ARKANSAS"
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Caption - the county in "COURT OF ________, ARKANSAS"
requiredBeforeFiling.why: this blank binds participant.city through its own field name, which is the wrong fact; the county of the filing court is a case fact the participant establishes
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the county of the court where the nolle prosequi, dismissal or judgment of acquittal was entered - not the county you live in

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Caption - the type of court in "IN THE ______ COURT OF"
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Caption - the type of court in "IN THE ______ COURT OF"
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the compiled profile records that Act 1460 sealing is filed in the circuit or district court that handled the case, and which of the two varies by county
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: which Arkansas court takes an Act 1460 non-conviction petition where your order was entered - circuit or district; the circuit clerk's office of that county answers it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Paragraph 1 - the DAY of the arrest date
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Paragraph 1 - the DAY of the arrest date
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds an arrest date as a whole and holds no day fact
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the day of the month you were arrested, copied from your arrest paperwork

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Paragraph 1 - "in violation of A.C.A. Sec. ______"
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Paragraph 1 - "in violation of A.C.A. Sec. ______"
requiredBeforeFiling.identity: petition field in violation of ACA
requiredBeforeFiling.why: this blank binds matter.charge through its printed caption, but it holds a code section rather than an offence name
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the Arkansas Code section of the offence, copied from your arrest or court paperwork or from your ACIC record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Paragraph 1 - the MONTH of the arrest date
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Paragraph 1 - the MONTH of the arrest date
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds no month fact, and this blank class was proved on the sibling ACIC form to take a participant name through the printed-label fallback
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the month you were arrested, copied from the same paperwork

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Verification - "Comes the Petitioner, ______, under oath and states"
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Verification - "Comes the Petitioner, ______, under oath and states"
requiredBeforeFiling.why: this one field also controls the notarised signature rule at the foot of the jurat, and a packet may never put a name on a signature line, so the field is refused whole
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your own name, written on the page you swear before the notary

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Identification block - Race
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Identification block - Race
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform does not hold or write a race fact
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your race, as the form asks; the form states this block is required for proper identification of the Defendant in the state and national record systems

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Identification block - Sex
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Identification block - Sex
requiredBeforeFiling.why: this blank binds participant.date_of_birth through the printed-label fallback, because the block prints Sex and DOB one line apart; a date of birth in the sex box is a wrong answer rather than a missing one
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your sex, as the form asks, in the same identification block

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Identification block - SID No.
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Identification block - SID No.
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds no SID, and the shared semantics refuse a government identifier on any form
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your State Identification number, from your arrest paperwork or your ACIC criminal-history record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Paragraph 1 - the YEAR of the arrest date
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Paragraph 1 - the YEAR of the arrest date
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds no year fact
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the year you were arrested, copied from the same paperwork

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Order paragraph 1 - the offence(s) in the court's findings, first printed rule
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Order paragraph 1 - the offence(s) in the court's findings, first printed rule
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the order is the court's instrument and accepts caption facts only; its findings are not caption facts
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: nothing unless the clerk asks you to complete the recitals; then the offence, as on the petition

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Order paragraph 1 - "in violation of A.C.A. Sec." in the court's findings
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Order paragraph 1 - "in violation of A.C.A. Sec." in the court's findings
requiredBeforeFiling.why: this blank binds matter.charge through its printed caption but holds a code section, and the findings are the court's
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: nothing unless the clerk asks you to complete the recitals; then the Arkansas Code section, as on the petition

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Order identification block - Arrest Tracking Number
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Order identification block - Arrest Tracking Number
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the ATN is assigned by Arkansas ACIC and is the agency's identifier
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the same ATN you wrote on the petition

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Order paragraph 1 - the "A Class ______" blank in the court's findings
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Order paragraph 1 - the "A Class ______" blank in the court's findings
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds no offence-class fact, and the findings are the court's
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: nothing unless the clerk asks you to complete the recitals; then the class letter of the offence

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Order caption - the county, which must match the petition's
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Order caption - the county, which must match the petition's
requiredBeforeFiling.why: this blank binds participant.city through its own field name, which is the wrong fact
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the same county you wrote in the petition's caption - the county of the court where the order was entered

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Order caption - the type of court, which must match the petition's
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Order caption - the type of court, which must match the petition's
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the order travels with the petition and carries the same caption the participant establishes
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the same court you wrote in the petition's caption

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Order paragraph 1 - the DAY of the arrest date in the court's findings
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Order paragraph 1 - the DAY of the arrest date in the court's findings
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds no day fact, and the recitals below the caption are the court's
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: nothing unless the clerk asks you to complete the order's recitals to match your petition; then the day of the arrest, as on the petition

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Order paragraph 1 - the MONTH of the arrest date in the court's findings
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Order paragraph 1 - the MONTH of the arrest date in the court's findings
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds no month fact, and the recitals below the caption are the court's
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: nothing unless the clerk asks you to complete the recitals; then the month, as on the petition

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Order identification block - Race
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Order identification block - Race
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform does not hold or write a race fact
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the same race entry you wrote on the petition

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Order identification block - Sex
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Order identification block - Sex
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform does not hold a sex fact
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the same sex entry you wrote on the petition

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Order identification block - SID No.
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Order identification block - SID No.
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds no SID, and the shared semantics refuse a government identifier
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the same SID you wrote on the petition

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Order paragraph 1 - the YEAR of the arrest date in the court's findings
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Order paragraph 1 - the YEAR of the arrest date in the court's findings
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds no year fact, and the recitals below the caption are the court's
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: nothing unless the clerk asks you to complete the recitals; then the year, as on the petition
